name: calendar-heatmap
purpose: Accessible SVG calendar heatmap: one square per day in a week-by-weekday grid (weeks as columns, weekdays as rows starting at the locale's first day of the week) over a calendar year or a range, with month labels. Fills encode values in discrete steps listed in the legend. With a business calendar, non-working days get a dashed outline and holidays a dot and their name, so a quiet weekend never reads as missing activity. Day and week keyboard navigation, value tooltips, a summary, and a data table are built in.
whenToUse: Daily activity over a year: absences, commits, sales, support tickets.
Spotting weekly and seasonal patterns, and how they relate to working days and holidays.
whenNotToUse: Exact comparison of a few days: use Bar Chart.
Hourly patterns: use Heatmap (weekday by hour).
More than three years: aggregate by week or month.
states: with business calendar (non-working days and holidays marked)
responsive: The width follows the container (ResizeObserver); day squares are sized to fit all weeks in the width (and seven rows in the height). Month labels are thinned when crowded; weekday labels show every other row (auto). Wide data tables scroll in a focusable region.
rtl: direction rtl puts the first week on the right and the weekday labels on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (previous / next week).
theme: Steps mix color-chart-<slot> into color-surface at 15-100%; days without value use color-surface-sunken; non-working days get a dashed color-border-strong outline; holiday dots use color-text; hover and focus outline color-text. Forced colors: outlined squares (Canvas / CanvasText), Highlight on focus.
timezone: Dates are PlainDate values (calendar days without a time zone), so no time zone conversion happens.
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, legend, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS; positions and per-item colors are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty) or as SVG geometry. No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: CalendarHeatmap.create for one year (365 days) with a business calendar, including the first render

performance.testedScale: One to three years (up to 1,098 days); every day is a focusable SVG rect.

limitations: Daily values only (PlainDate); no hourly breakdown.
Discrete sequential steps (3-9) of one palette slot.
antiPatterns: Hiding the legend and the data table together (lightness would be the only cue).
Comparing activity across weekends without a business calendar (zero weekends look like missing data).
